Recycled-content %, waste data, any measured outcomes

Anthropic API key for Mira; usage budget
File storage for uploads (Vercel Blob or CRM)
RFQ uploads beyond email size limit
Production domain (e.g. merova.in / merovaprintpack.com) and DNS access
Privacy Policy and Terms review (DPDP Act 2023)
